Complete assignment thoroughly:

# Target
Worktree `/Users/bnjoroge/preloop-gh-app-api-compat`. Files: `crates/preloop-cli/src/github_setup.rs`, `crates/preloop-runner-server/src/config.rs`, `crates/preloop-cli/src/app_manifest.rs`. Do NOT edit other files.

# Change (three items, verified open at head b4c00985)
1. **Registry-only config falls into browser flow (P1)** — `setup_app` in github_setup.rs (~line 270-295): when `config.github` has only `github.apps` entries (no legacy `app_id`/`app_pem`), `has_configured_app` is true but the inner `if let (Some(app_id), Some(pem)) = (&existing.app_id, &existing.app_pem)` fails, so control falls through to `setup_app_via_browser(args)` — creating a SECOND App on a normal `preloop setup github --via app` run. Fix: when `has_configured_app && !args.add`, ALWAYS return without launching the browser flow. If a primary App exists, keep today's behavior (webhook enable when `--public-url` given, else the informative message). If only registry Apps exist, print an informative message naming the registry (mention `--add` to create an additional App via browser, `--app-id/--pem-file` to add credentials manually) and return Ok. Match the existing message style.
2. **Numeric App ids rejected (P2)** — `AppConfig.app_id: String` in config.rs (~line 68-78) is deserialized from `PRELOOP_GITHUB_APPS_JSON` (`serde_json::from_str::<Vec<AppConfig>>` at github_app.rs ~line 468-474); GitHub's App ids are numbers, so `[{"app_id": 12345, ...}]` fails. Fix: make `AppConfig` accept string OR integer `app_id` on deserialize while still serializing as the type used today. Use a serde `deserialize_with` helper on the `app_id` field (e.g. `fn de_string_or_u64<'de, D>(d: D) -> Result<String, D::Error>` accepting `String` or any integer via `serde_json::Value`/`deserialize_any` and converting to string; reject other types with a clear error). Keep `Serialize` as plain string. Do not change other fields. Verify the helper is placed in config.rs near `AppConfig` and is `#[allow(dead_code)]`-free (it is used).
3. **Manifest permissions broadened beyond the documented floor (P2)** — `DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS` in app_manifest.rs (~line 44-53) added `("actions","read"), ("issues","read"), ("discussions","read"), ("deployments","read"), ("members","read"), ("pages","read")` to the original `checks:write, contents:read, metadata:read, pull_requests:read`. The stated rationale in docs/github-app-api-compat.md ("so the expanded event list is deliverable") is stale: the event defaults were reverted to minimal `push`/`pull_request` in b4c00985, and nothing in the dispatch API mints `actions` or the other scopes (dispatch minting requests `contents:read` only). Fix: revert `DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS` to exactly `checks:write, contents:read, metadata:read, pull_requests:read`. If `PRELOOP_GITHUB_APP_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS` or similar override exists in the file, leave it as-is. Check the test at the bottom of app_manifest.rs (manifest tests) — if it asserts the added scopes, update it to assert the reverted set. Report whether any other file references the added scopes.

# Acceptance
- All changes compile-read coherently (serde attribute syntax correct, imports for `serde::Deserializer`/`de` helpers added to config.rs only if needed).
- Do NOT run cargo. Report per item: exact changes and functions touched, plus any test updates.

data.summary: All three review items fixed in /Users/bnjoroge/preloop-gh-app-api-compat (branch Bnjoroge/gh-app-api-compat). No cargo run. No test updates were needed — none of the existing tests assert the changed behavior.

1_registry_only_config_browser_flow_P1.change: Inside `if has_configured_app && !args.add`, after the `if let (Some(app_id), Some(pem))` primary-App branch (unchanged: webhook enable via --public-url, else the existing informative message), added a new branch that fires when the `if let` fails — i.e. only registry Apps exist (no legacy primary). It prints: `GitHub Apps are already configured in the `github.apps` registry in {config_path}.` followed by the same style of `\x20`-indented hints (`--add` to create an additional App via browser and add it to the registry; `--app-id/--pem-file` to add/update an App with existing credentials) and `return Ok(())`. Control can no longer fall through to `setup_app_via_browser(args)` when any App is configured and `--add` is absent. Primary-App behavior and `--add` behavior are byte-for-byte unchanged.
1_registry_only_config_browser_flow_P1.tests: none cover this path; no update needed

2_numeric_app_ids_rejected_P2.function: AppConfig::app_id + new helper de_string_or_integer (placed immediately after the AppConfig struct, no #[allow(dead_code)] — it is referenced by the attribute)
2_numeric_app_ids_rejected_P2.change: Added `#[serde(deserialize_with = "de_string_or_integer")]` to `app_id: String`. The helper is a serde `deserialize_any` visitor (`use serde::de::Visitor` imported locally inside the fn; `serde::Deserializer` fully qualified; no new top-level imports) accepting `visit_str`/`visit_string` and any integer (`visit_u64`/`visit_i64`, converted via `to_string()`); floats, bools, null, arrays, objects are rejected by the default error path with a clear message (`invalid type: ..., expected a string or integer` via `expecting`). Works for both deserialization paths: JSON (`PRELOOP_GITHUB_APPS_JSON`, github_app.rs ~468-474) and TOML (`github.apps` in config.toml — toml integers dispatch to visit_i64). `Serialize` is untouched, so `app_id` still serializes as a plain string (the type used today). Other fields unchanged. The struct's `Default` derive is unaffected.
2_numeric_app_ids_rejected_P2.tests: no test asserts the old strict behavior; no update needed

3_manifest_permissions_P2.function: DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS (consumed by manifest() and the form page renderer, both generic over the slice)
3_manifest_permissions_P2.change: Reverted DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS to exactly the documented floor: checks:write, contents:read, metadata:read, pull_requests:read (removed actions/issues/discussions/deployments/members/pages — all read). The doc comment above the const already describes precisely this reverted set, so it is unchanged. No `PRELOOP_GITHUB_APP_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS` override exists anywhere in the repo to preserve.
3_manifest_permissions_P2.tests: app_manifest.rs tests only assert `default_permissions["contents"] == "read"` and default_events (push/pull_request) — no test asserts the removed scopes, so none were updated.
other_references_to_added_scopes: crates/preloop-runner-server/src/github.rs::github_register (~1489-1501): the server-side /api/v1/github/register page builds its own INLINE default_permissions with the same broadened 10-scope set. Out of my assigned file list — left untouched; it carries the identical stale broadening and may warrant the same revert.

crates/preloop-runner-server/src/github_app.rs::PROBED_PERMISSIONS (~999-1004: contents/pull-requests/actions/issues read): probe set for verify_repo_access_with_token (preloop setup/doctor verification) — a different purpose, not a manifest default; untouched.

crates/preloop-gha-parser/src/expand.rs PERMISSION_SCOPES (~202-207: contents, deployments, discussions, id-token, issues, ...): the parser's complete workflow-permission list used for read-all/write-all expansion in the PAT checklist — unrelated to the App manifest; untouched.
